raw_instruction: Clarify the following agreements with changes in red
raw_qualification: The switching period is only applicable when the scheduled UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2.

all_affected_properties.value_json:
"For standalone SUL, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is only applicable when the scheduled UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2.
For each UL transmission occasion on a carrier, the existence of the switching period is determined one time every occasion."
"2Tx carrier 2 refers to an UL carrier capable of 2 Tx chains and both 1-port and 2-port UL transmissions."

"For inter-band UL CA, if UL switching period is configured by RRC\nThe switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.\nThe switching period is at least applicable between 1-port transmission in carrier 1 and 2-port transmission in carrier 2."

"For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured:\nFor option 1 of mapping between UL transmission ports and Tx chain, the switching period is only applicable when the UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2."

"2Tx carrier 2 refers to an UL carrier capable of 2 Tx chains and both 1-port and 2-port UL transmissions.
For option 2 of mapping between UL transmission ports and Tx chain
The switching period is only applicable in the following cases:
If the current state of Tx chains is 1 Tx on carrier 1 and 1Tx on carrier 2, the next UL transmission has a 2-port transmission on carrier 2.
If the current state of Tx chains is 0 Tx on carrier 1 and 2Tx on carrier 2, the next UL transmission has a 1-port transmission on carrier 1.
For other cases, the state of Tx chains of last UL transmission is assumed.
Note: No spec change to power configuration and power control."

"For standalone SUL, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is only applicable when the scheduled UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2.
For each UL transmission occasion on a carrier, the existence of the switching period is determined one time every occasion."

"in the reply LS to RAN4, add a bit more details explaining UL transmission occasion based on 38.213.
Friday session
R1-1913495	Offline summary#2 of Tx switching between two uplink carriers	China Telecom
Decision: The document is noted."

"For inter-band UL CA, if option 2 is supported, the following sub-option 2-3 is defined.
Minimize RAN1 impact
No new RAN4 impact
No new TDM pattern
It can be revisited in future RAN1 meeting with taking into consideration any relevant RAN4 decisions on DL interruption for UL Tx switching.
Option 2-3
|  | Number of  Tx chains  in WID (carrier 1 + carrier 2) | Number of  antenna ports  for UL transmission (carrier 1 + carrier 2) |
| Case 1 | 1T+1T | 1P+0P, 1P+1P, 0P+1P |
| Case 2 | 0T+2T | 0P+2P, 0P+1P |"
